I am a 46-year-old woman farming here in SNNP. This small plot of 0.22 hectares is just one piece of my land, and I grow something other than the main cereals on it — I put my manure from the animals here because it costs me nothing, and I save the fertilizer I can afford for my bigger plots where maize and teff grow. I will use my own seed saved from last season, and my daughters and I will weed it by hand. I cannot afford pesticide or to hire workers for such a small plot, and we have no irrigation here — we wait for the meher rains like everyone else.
